annotations.title: Insider trading, SEC Form 4: trades by company

description: Recent insider trades in a US-listed company from its SEC Form 4 filings: who traded (name and role: director, officer title, 10% owner), date, buy or sell (open-market purchase, sale, award, option exercise, tax withholding), shares, price, dollar value, holding afterwards and whether it was under a 10b5-1 plan. Up to 10 filings, newest first. Public SEC EDGAR data. Use to see whether insiders are buying or selling. Example: ticker=AAPL. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key of the company (instead of ticker)

ticker.description: Stock ticker or company name, e.g. AAPL (or give cik)
